source: Aria Networks — MFU as defining AI-factory metric; lowest-cost token producer wins via high-performance infra
summary: AI is the first major tech sector where being the lowest-cost producer of the core output (tokens/intelligence) is the decisive competitive advantage
summary_extended: Baker argues that AI represents a historically unprecedented structural shift where being the lowest-cost producer of the core output — tokens or intelligence — is the decisive competitive advantage, a dynamic he has never observed in any prior major tech sector during his career. Unlike smartphones (Apple) or accelerators (Nvidia), where product quality and performance command premium pricing and margins, AI model deployment economics are governed by cost-per-token multiplied by token efficiency, meaning the cheapest intelligence producer can either reinvest savings into quality improvements or capture superior margins. Baker draws an explicit analogy to extraction industries like oil and mining, where low-cost producers structurally and persistently outcompete higher-cost rivals, suggesting AI model economics will follow the same winner-take-most logic. The investment implication is that infrastructure enabling maximum MFU (Model FLOP Utilization) — the metric Baker identifies as defining AI factory efficiency — will be the critical determinant of which AI companies survive and dominate, and Baker's board seat at Aria Networks, whose product thesis is built on this exact premise, underscores his conviction. No specific publicly traded equities are named or unambiguously implied as direct subjects or beneficiaries in this particular thesis segment.
detail: Unlike Apple (smartphones) or Nvidia (accelerators), where quality/performance dominates, AI model deployment economics are governed by cost per token × token efficiency. The lowest-cost intelligence producer can either reinvest savings into quality or margin, making this structurally analogous to extraction industries (oil, mining) where low-cost producers always win.
confidence_evidence: Baker states this as a foundational structural view, uses multiple analogies, and frames it as a career-defining observation. He is also a board member of Aria Networks, whose product thesis depends on this view.
